527:t_017:3.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「You're isolated and helpless! We've got the $$新地球皇国$$ behind us and can do whatever we like! How do you think you can win like this!?」

527:t_017:5.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「You call me a stray dog with that beautiful-girl voice!?」

527:t_017:6.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We are not the only ones who keep fighting and never give up.」

527:t_017:7.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I have no intention of kissing the boots of arrogant bastards like you who look down on everyone and play at being rulers!」

527:t_017:9.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We are not isolated... $$相良$$, a reliable partner will be with you soon.」

527:t_017:11.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Before that, I'll make sure you say goodbye to this world!」

527:t_018:2.en:
$n
「Sorry about that. I'm one of those never-give-up guys Captain $$テスタロッサ$$ was talking about, too.」

527:t_019:1.en:
$$アル$$
「It has been a while, Sergeant.」

527:t_019:3.en:
$$アル$$
「Affirmative. However, this unit's designation is $$ＡＲＸ－８　レーバテイン$$.」

527:t_019:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「But that was supposed to have been destroyed...!」

527:t_019:6.en:
$$アル$$
「The unit $$アマルガム$$ captured was a decoy, built to conceal this unit's existence.」

527:t_019:7.en:
$$アル$$
「Sergeant $$相良$$... I request permission to return to your war.」

527:t_020:0.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「I don't like it! That machine... There's something about it I don't like!!」

527:t_021:2.en:
$$マオ$$
「It's beyond everything we know about AS...」

527:t_021:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「Ngh... My consciousness is being pulled away...!? Al! The output setting...!」

527:t_021:4.en:
$$アル$$
「That was 80%. Did you enjoy it?」

527:t_021:6.en:
$$アル$$
「Actually, this unit was built in secret, so it has not even gone through proper test runs.」

527:t_021:8.en:
$$アル$$
「This unit was built in secret, in an extremely limited environment.」

527:t_021:9.en:
$$アル$$
「I requested an operation test at a training ground myself, but Mr. $$ハンター$$ turned it down.」

527:t_021:10.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$ハンター$$... You mean $$ギャビン・ハンター$$ of Intelligence?」

527:t_021:12.en:
$$アル$$
「For that reason, it is naturally unclear whether the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ will even function.」

527:t_021:14.en:
$$アル$$
「Incoming. That color... The enemy operator may be the $$赤い彗星$$.」

527:t_021:15.en:
$$宗介$$
「What do you take Colonel $$シャア$$ for!?」

527:t_021:16.en:
$$アル$$
「Also, as you may be aware, the enemy unit is equipped with a $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$. If possible, this unit also...」

527:t_021:17.en:
$$宗介$$
「I don't care anymore! We'll test it right here, cold!」

527:t_022:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「All right...! The $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ works!」

527:t_022:2.en:
$$アル$$
「I have just confirmed it. As you are now, Sergeant, you appear able to fight with the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ active at all times.」

527:t_022:3.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「I won't allow it! I won't allow you, new model!!」

527:t_023:0.en:
$$アル$$
「It appears the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ is what holds the frame together.」

527:t_023:5.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Al... I welcome your return.」

527:t_023:6.en:
$$アル$$
「It seems Chamber has learned to joke while I was away.」

527:t_023:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「That was a pun, wasn't it?」

527:t_023:8.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit has shown its growth. Next is your turn.」

527:t_024:0.en:
$n
「I'll back you up. Give it everything you've got, $$宗介$$.」

527:t_025:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「We'll butcher them in three minutes.」

527:t_025:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「Let's go, partner! Nothing can stand against us!!」

527:t_026:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「The enemy's destruction is confirmed, but neither Miss $$千鳥$$ nor $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$...」

527:t_026:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Even so, we were able to show $$アマルガム$$ our resolve. That is enough for now.」

527:t_026:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「...Al, how long did it take?」

527:t_026:3.en:
$$アル$$
「Cleared within three minutes, as you declared. Well done, Sergeant.」

527:t_026:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「That much is a piece of cake.」

527:t_026:5.en:
$n
「Don't talk like it was all your doing.」

527:t_026:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「Right, right. It's only thanks to all of us doing our best, you know.」

527:t_026:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「Still... I'm glad you're safe, Al.」

527:t_026:11.en:
$$アル$$
「That much, at least, I tell you from my heart.」

527:t_026:12.en:
$$宗介$$
「Hmph... Talking about a heart, for a machine...」

527:t_026:13.en:
$$宗介$$
(It's like a conversation between comrades-in-arms, but strangely, it doesn't feel bad...)

527:t_026:14.en:
$$マオ$$
「Machine spotted to the north-northeast! It's the one trying to get away from here using $$ＥＣＳ$$!」
